audit.source: NASA COOLR atlas snapshot; not an authoritative complete event inventory

priorities.title: Verified event inventory
priorities.started: Real report audit, candidate review CSV and event/coverage templates.
priorities.next: Source review, deduplication, mapped units and bounded event timing.

priorities.title: Historical rainfall
priorities.started: Availability-aware 24/72/168-hour features; existing IMERG access check.

priorities.title: Explicit forecast target

priorities.title: Comparison models

priorities.title: Field observations
priorities.started: Site screening, sensor QA and survey/maintenance recording templates.
priorities.next: Qualified assessment, permissions, equipment and actual monitoring.

priorities.title: Reproducible research
priorities.status: Code and CI ready; scientific release pending
